{{Quote|You're a Jedi? Jedi do not fall so easily boy. The ages have obviously not been kind to the Order. Tell me who you serve&mdash;before I punish your lack of skill with death.|[[Celeste Morne]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Rebellion 16" />}}
The '''Second duel on unidentified desert moon''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel fought nine months following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] between Luke Skywalker and unstable [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Celeste Morne]] on a desolate [[Unidentified desert moon|moon]] orbiting a gas planet.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|She still lives. Interesting. And she '''will''' serve me -- whether she knows it or not.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Rebellion 15" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] came in possession of [[Dreypa's Oubliette]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] which placed it's occupant in [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis]]. He believed that the oubliette contained a powerful Sith artifact known as the [[Muur Talisman]] and a Jedi from centuries ago. In the hopes that he could claim the power of the Talisman and gain the mystery Jedi as an apprentice, Vader opened the oubliette where a healthy [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Celeste Morne]], emerged. Once she realized that Vader was a Sith Lord a lightsaber [[First duel on unidentified desert moon|duel]] began between the two of them.<ref name="Dark Times 11">[[Dark Times 11|''Dark Times'' 11]]</ref> Even though Vader disarmed her, Celeste used the Muur Talisman to transform Vader's stormtroopers into [[rakghoul]]s, forcing him into retreat off the moon and at the same time leaving her stranded.<ref name="Dark Times 12">[[Dark Times 12|''Dark Times'' 12]]</ref>

About nineteen years later Vader's thoughts drifted back to Celeste and he wondered if he could use her against the current [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] against the Sith-led Empire. He sent an Imperial convoy on a mission to confirm whether Celeste was still alive. As the convoy descended to the moon's surface transmissions ended when Celeste transformed the pilots into rakghouls and crashed the shuttles. Thus Vader knew Celeste still lived and he ordered former Rebel spy, [[Wyl Tarson]] to send a message to the Rebellion concerning a secret Imperial weapon. In response a group of rebels lead by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] landed on the moon in order to follow up on the message.<ref name="Rebellion 15" />

For almost twenty years Celeste had lived alone on the moon and the spirit of the Sith Lord [[Karness Muur]] haunted her to the point of insanity, developing not only a hatred for Vader, but also for the Jedi.<ref name="Rebellion 16" /><ref name="Rebellion 15" />Therefore, as the rebels began to survey the crash site of the Imperial shuttles, the rakghouls Celeste controlled attacked them and dragged Luke and Leia to a cave where Celeste waited ready to strike.<ref name="Rebellion 15" />

==Duel==
{{Quote|The Jedi abandoned you. [...] Vader abandoned you. They all left you here. [...] Make them pay!|Karness Muur to Celeste Morne|<ref name="Rebellion 16" />}}
[[File:Celeste_vs_Luke.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Morne attacks Luke Skywalker.]]The battle began with Celeste Morne assaulting Luke Skywalker. Luke deflected the first few strikes, but then Celeste used telekinesis to overpower Luke Skywalker. Pushed on his back foot, Luke suffered multiple hits from Celeste Morne before being kicked aside and defeated. Morne then held her Lightsaber next to the throat of a defeated Luke.
